# LibreBugBounty 2.0.2 “Moneta”

This release adds a local, human-controlled disclosure workflow and improves
navigation and operational visibility. There is no automatic outreach or new
reminder worker.

## Highlights

- **Saved and recent views:** save, rename and reopen Inventory filter combinations;
  recent views stay in your browser.
- **Follow-up and restrictions:** pursue or close cases independently of their
  assessment. Manage case and exact-hostname contact/check restrictions in Settings,
  including hostnames without remaining cases. Audit history and form revisions
  protect against stale tabs.
- **Contact selection:** request security.txt suggestions explicitly, then choose
  one email/form/portal route or enter a contact manually. Source snapshots survive
  subsequent lookups. No messages are sent and no restrictions are lifted.
- **Disclosure records and reminders:** document reports, responses and notes with
  date, channel, recipient and optional ticket/comment. Keep one manual reminder
  per case; Today/Overdue/Open filters work with saved views. Historical contact
  and sent markers are not rewritten.
- **Diagnostics:** inspect per-worker health, browser-service reachability, retained
  screenshot comparisons and case-linked errors without changing assessments.

## Upgrade

1. Create and verify a complete [database and artifact backup](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.0.2/BACKUP.md).
2. Update the checkout and apply the database migrations:
   `ddev exec php bin/console app:db:init`.
3. Review Settings health and the case detail page. Missing migrations produce
   explanatory UI states.

The additive migrations are `Version20261010000000`,
`Version20261010010000` and `Version20261010020000`. They preserve existing
assessments, evidence and historical markers; old markers are not inferred into
new disclosure activities. Destructive rollback is refused: restore a deliberate
backup instead.

## Verification

- 458 PHP tests and 15,752 assertions passed for the feature release.
- 27 isolated browser verification blocks covered German/English, mobile/desktop
  and JavaScript/native-form workflows without external target requests.

## Release correction

The initial `v2.0.2` publication retained a 2.0.1 title and application version.
This corrected release aligns the application, documentation and title with
2.0.2. The tag is updated to include the metadata correction; installations using
an earlier copy of the tag should verify the release commit before updating.
